summary: RoCEnante collectives now connect on switchless DGX Spark rings instead of falling back to NCCL
details: Each peer's two rails use the RoCE devices that share a subnet with it, so three Sparks cabled in a ring without a switch can use RoCEnante.
Switched fabrics keep the previous device pairing.
On a ring, list all four port functions in B12X_ROCE_HCA or NCCL_IB_HCA.
